source: Steam patch notes 1.0.1, 1.0.2 and hotfix 1.0.2a (the wiki pages behind abilities.json and status_effects.json were not updated yet); item effects from patch 1.0.2

Ice Shards.description: Hurl an icy shard that strikes a single enemy for 115% weapon damage.

Flame Lightning.description: Call down a bolt of flame and lightning on a random enemy, dealing 60% weapon damage as Fire and 60% weapon damage as Lightning.

Venom Bolt.description: Fire a powerful poisoned projectile that bursts on impact, dealing 160% weapon damage as Poison damage to all nearby enemies and inflicting 2 stacks of Poisoned.

Poison Trap.description: Throw a trap that detonates when an enemy steps on it, dealing 200% weapon damage as Poison damage to everything nearby with a 100% chance to inflict 3 stacks of Poisoned.

Frost Trap.name: Arcane Trap
Frost Trap.description: Throw a trap that detonates when an enemy steps on it, dealing 300% weapon damage as Arcane damage to everything nearby, immobilizing them with Arcane Grip for 5 seconds and applying Dizzy.

Golden Palms.description: Send two golden palms travelling forward through every enemy in their path for 160% weapon damage, knocking them back.

Electrostatic.duration: Lasts 4 s, stacks up to 10 times

Poisoned.text: Take 75% weapon damage as Poison damage every 2 seconds. Stacks up to 150 times.
Poisoned.duration: Lasts 6 s at level 1, +0.5 s per level, stacks up to 150 times, ticks every 2 s

Staff of the Frostwyrm.effect: Ice Shards deflect to 2 additional enemies on hit.

Violet Skybow.effect_db: Your attack hits have a 20% chance to rain multiple Arcane daggers down at the target's position. Each dagger hit deals 275% weapon damage as Arcane.
Violet Skybow.effect: Attack hits have a 20% chance to rain Arcane daggers, each dealing 275% weapon damage.

Soulrender.effect_db: Every hit grants a stack of Harvest of Souls. Consumes 25 stacks to release Soul Impact, a forward-travelling soul wave dealing 800% Weapon Damage as Physical Damage to every enemy in its path (range 15) and applying Dazed to them.
Soulrender.effect: Every hit grants a stack of Harvest of Souls. Consumes 25 stacks to release Soul Impact, dealing 800% Weapon Damage.
